description: Two-alloy IN718 self-improvement loop, arm=maximinrepl, round 2: 10 acquired training cases. Solved in the ds86529 domain (900x600x450+100 um @ 10 um) so they compose with the Ti64 anchor set and are evaluable by base model 86651. TRAINING cases -- the frozen IN718 test set is batch 86840 and is never mixed in. Acquisition: diminishing-returns bandit -- region chosen by w_r*(E_r*b_r+c)/(n_r+1), point chosen by maximin within it.
